foodSubtitle: Check what’s open for ordering on campus, right now.
favoritesSubtitle: Your saved spots, with the same up-to-date order checks.
infoSubtitle: What our statuses mean, and where they come from.
demoNotice: Sample availability only. Switch to live checks before deciding where to eat.
offline: You’re offline. Live availability is unknown.
apiError: Could not refresh. Previous results remain only until their three-minute expiry; retrying automatically.
favoriteError: Favorites work this visit, but this browser could not save them.
serviceFacts: Supported online order modes; separate from current availability.
noServices: Online order modes are not published.
choose: Choose a confirmed place and go straight to ordering.
noConfirmed: No restaurant has confirmed ordering availability yet.
coverage: web restaurants have a confirmed status
background: Automatic checks run in the background.
favoritesHint: A little collection of campus comfort.
orderHint: Places with confirmed current ordering availability.
allHint: All outlets, with their latest automatic check results.
saveHint: Tap the heart on any restaurant to save it here.
checkingHint: We are checking automatically. All places shows unresolved outlets.
filterHint: Try another status or clear your search.
source: Real ordering status. No opening-hour guesses.
unresolved: Unconfirmed outlets stay in All places and are not counted as orderable.
footer: Made for hungry minds at PolyU.
intro: A restaurant being open doesn’t always mean it can take your order. Eats Now checks the official system for current ordering evidence.
OPENInfo: Current ordering is enabled, with at least one purchasable food or drink.
LIMITEDInfo: The official system restricts ordering, or only one Block Y brand is confirmed available.
CLOSEDInfo: The official system explicitly says current ordering is unavailable.
UNKNOWNInfo: No reliable evidence, a sign-in barrier, a failed check, or evidence older than three minutes.
sourceIntro: Online dine-in / takeaway labels describe supported online order modes, not the availability of seats. A takeaway-only website can belong to a restaurant with seating.
factsInfo: Confirmed support stays visible even if a status check fails. Unpublished modes are omitted; missing information is never treated as “not supported”.
mealInfo: Breakfast, lunch and dinner menus change. Checks inspect the current official menu and other categories; one sold-out category does not close the whole restaurant.
notesInfo: Only confirmed payment options are marked. Block Y requires a phone in portrait orientation and has a 15-minute ordering session. The official page controls its timer and final availability.
privacy: Favorites and language are saved on this device. No account, payment handling or location access is needed.
languageInfo: Names prefer official terminology. Where no verified Chinese brand name exists, the English brand is retained; translated facility descriptions are identified in the data. Simplified Chinese converts the official Chinese spelling; original brand names are retained.
launchIntro: This official ordering system requires a phone in portrait orientation. Scan with your phone camera or copy the link.
sessionNote: Complete ordering within the official 15-minute session. If it expires, reopen the official entry page. Its countdown starts on the official site.
paymentNote: Online checkout is offered on the official site. Payment methods and final availability are confirmed there.
copyError: Select and copy the link below.
qrAlt: QR code for the official Block Y ordering page
logo: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University logo
initialCheckingHint: Confirmed places appear as checks finish. This does not mean all restaurants are closed.
glossaryIntro: In Hong Kong ordering, “走 X” means “without X”. Keep the merchant’s wording beside the explanation.
lessIceMeaning: Less ice; not the same as no ice
glossaryFuture: For now, use this guide alongside the official ordering page. Menu explanations can later show the original item and a plain-language explanation together.
checkDelayed: Latest refresh failed. Showing the verified result from the time below, valid for up to 3 minutes.
